name: 饿了么
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=饿了么
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = elemecdn.com, fuss10.elemecdn.com, cube.elemecdn.com, www1.elecfans.com, nr-op.elemecdn.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/elemecdn\.com\/.+\/sitemap/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/fuss10\.elemecdn\.com\/.+\/w\/640\/h\/\d{3,4}/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/fuss10\.elemecdn\.com\/.+\/w\/750\/h\/\d{3,4}/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/fuss10\.elemecdn\.com\/.+?\.mp4/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cube\.elemecdn\.com\/[\w\/]+\.jpeg\?x-oss-process=image\/resize,m_fill,w_1\d{3},h_2\d{3}\/format,webp\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cube\.elemecdn\.com\/[\w\/]+\.jpeg\?x-oss-process=image\/resize,m_fill,w_6\d{2},h_8\d{2}\/format,webp\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cube\.elemecdn\.com\/[\w\/]+\.jpeg\?x-oss-process=image\/resize,m_fill,w_\d{3},h_\d{4}\/format,webp\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cube\.elemecdn\.com\/\w\/\w{2}\/\w+mp4\.mp4\?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/www1\.elecfans\.com\/www\/delivery\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(nr-op|cube)\.elemecdn\.com\/.+\.jpeg\?x-oss-process=image\/resize,m_fill,w_\d{4,},h_\d{4,}\/($|format,webp\/$)/i then reject(404)
